results.fact: Elevation of the glacier-exit / moat transition below the col
results.evidence: The 6,200 ft figure in the prose is where the standard description has parties exit left up a short cliff onto the glacial remnants; the waypoint instead names a moat/snow-gully top. Sources place the moat differently: one trip report puts the moat and ~200 ft of steep slabs just below the notch above 7,200 ft, another says a moat forms halfway up the steep snow, and a route database puts the snow-finger exit at 4,800-5,000 ft. The waypoint may be a different feature than the 6,200 ft exit, and no two sources give an elevation for it, so no patch.

results.fact: Which national forest manages the trailhead (duplicate landManager/land_manager keys disagree)
results.evidence: Lemah Mountain sits on the Cascade crest on the King/Kittitas county line, so both forests border the peak; the Pete Lake trail and trailhead are run by the Cle Elum Ranger District of Okanogan-Wenatchee NF. One key names the trailhead's district, the other names both forests the peak straddles; both are true.

results.fact: Crux location and approach: beta/pitch_detail describe a NE-ridge/SW-face/E-face route from a Williams Lake camp, but this route's own approach/climbing_route/descent_text/waypoints describe a west-ridge/west-face route from a Chief Creek camp
results.evidence: A trip report from the Waptus / Chief Creek side gives 4,000+ ft of gain from the Chief Creek crossing and says the easiest route is still the Northeast Face (class 3-4), with the hardest move at an exposed notch on the north ridge. No source found documents a 'west ridge/west face' line from Chief Creek; the peak's west/northwest side faces Summit Chief Valley on the Middle Fork side, where the Falcon Route is. beta/pitch_detail describe the Dutch Miller Gap party's line. Which line this row is meant to be cannot be settled from two sources, and the face 'Northwest Face'/aspect NW may also be copied from the Falcon Route; no patch.

results.fact: Primary managing national forest (duplicate landManager/land_manager keys disagree)
